newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SAMMER TIPPED TO WIN FOOTBALLER OF THE YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SAMMER TIPPED TO WIN FOOTBALLER OF THE YEAR.

text.p: Matthias Sammer of German champions Borussia Dortmund seems set to win the European footballer of the year title for 1996 after attracting two-thirds of the votes in a poll organised by the magazine France Football.
Germany's SID sports news agency said Sammer could not now be overtaken.
It said Barcelona's Brazilian Ronaldo and England striker Alan Shearer of Newcastle United were lying in second and third places.
Fifty players were nominated for the poll which was won last year by Liberian George Weah of AC Milan.
